versions.changelog: Replaces direct-contact MCP quote submission with a read-only saved-plan handoff; buyers review and submit their own contact details on TempGuru form.
MCP v1.6.0 support, explicit saved-plan handoff, current policy tools, and quote attribution.

Version 1.5.1 of staffing-plan-from-event-brief contains no code or documentation changes.

- No changes detected in this version; the skill content and behavior remain the same as version 1.5.0.

- Expanded and clarified documentation to detail event document extraction, TempGuru role mapping, headcount heuristics, live quote math, and workflow.
- Added explicit usage instructions, mapping tables, and tool endpoint references for improved plan extraction and quoting accuracy.
- Introduced detailed step-by-step workflow for building, confirming, and submitting an event staffing plan.
- Emphasized compliance, attribution, and source runtime labeling requirements for API calls.
- Reinforced distinctions: not for permanent hiring, only for US/Canada events, and clarified limitations on security coverage.
- Added requirement to retain extracted plan details for accurate quoting and follow-up conversations.
